name: prelaunch-audit-report
description: Turns repo and live-URL security scanners into a severity-rated pre-launch audit report (JSON, HTML, PDF) with verified patch diffs, for Next.js/React + Supabase + Stripe apps. Personal project.
author: Sunnatulla E.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.sample: node src/cli.ts test/fixtures/broken-notes-app --out examples/sample-report --date 2026-11-09T09:00:00Z --note "Sample report. broken-notes-app is a small Next.js + Supabase + Stripe demo built with security holes on purpose (github.com/atokim4/supabase-scanner-bench). Every finding below is real scanner output on that code. It is not a client project."
